name: Irenebrug
source_mode: AI-generated reference sheet converted into individual game-reference assets

scale.notes: Known scale anchors are based on reported navigation opening dimensions rather than a full engineering drawing of the total bridge.

views.label: back
views.description: Reverse approach view with the bridge keeper house on the opposite side.

views.label: left

views.label: right
views.description: Right side elevation of the bridge over the water.

views.label: top
views.description: Top view of the bridge deck, sidewalks, openings and barrier positions.

views.label: line
views.description: Line-art reference with simplified front, side and top bridge views.

textures.label: road_texture
textures.description: Road surface texture with lane markings and bridge seam detail.

textures.label: barrier_texture
textures.description: Barrier pole and traffic light texture/reference.

notes: Model this bridge primarily as a readable game landmark rather than an engineering-accurate civil structure.
The most distinctive elements are the blue-white railings, striped barriers, traffic lights and the green-roof bridge keeper house.
Use the top view to block out roadway, sidewalks and water openings before refining the side details.

sources.label: Waterkaart Live
sources.note: Lists 4 navigable openings, each 10.5 m wide and 2.8 m high in closed state.
